title: Prime X Hub
features:
🎮 PRIME Hub - Feature Overview

🌟 Universal Features





🎨 5 Premium UI Themes - Dark Green, Dark Blue, Purple Rose, Skeet & Default



📱 Mobile & PC Optimized - Touch controls + drag-and-drop interface



💾 Auto-Save Settings - Your preferences stay saved across sessions

👁️ ESP & Visualization

Player ESP





📦 Box ESP - See players through walls with colored boxes



📏 Distance Display - Shows player name, role (Seeker/Hider), and distance



🔴 Role Indicators - Red for Seekers, Blue for Hiders

Coin ESP





💰 Coin Visualization - Yellow circles highlight all coins on map



🗺️ Real-time Updates - Tracks spawning and collected coins

🤖 Automation

Auto Collect Coins





⚡ Fast Collection - Automatically teleports to and collects all coins



🔄 Continuous Loop - Keeps collecting new coins as they spawn



🎯 Smart Detection - Reliable touch triggering system

Safe Location Teleport





🏠 Quick Escape - One-click teleport to safe zone



↩️ Return Option - Saves original position for easy return

🎯 Combat Features (Seeker Only)

Aimbot System





🔒 Auto-Lock - Automatically tracks nearest hider when enabled



👁️ FOV Circle - Visual indicator with adjustable size (50-300)



📍 Center Lock Option - Lock FOV to screen center or mouse



🚫 Wall Detection - Only targets visible players

🎨 UI Customization

Available Themes





🌊 Default - Cyan & Purple gradient



🌿 Dark Green - Nature-inspired theme



🌌 Dark Blue - Deep ocean vibes



🌸 Purple Rose - Elegant pink & purple



💚 Skeet - Lime green aesthetic

⚙️ Controls





Toggle Menu: Click the "P" button (draggable)



Minimize: "-" button in top bar



Close: "X" button to exit script



Drag: Grab top bar or buttons to reposition

🔧 Technical Features

✅ Smooth animations with TweenService
✅ Optimized rendering with RenderStepped
✅ Memory-efficient ESP cleanup
✅ Error handling with pcall protection
✅ No lag or performance drops

📱 Platform Support





✅ PC - Full keyboard & mouse support



✅ Mobile - Touch-optimized controls



✅ Tablet - Responsive UI scaling

👨‍💻 Credits

Developed by: WENDIGO & COSMIC
Hub Name: PRIME X HUB
Version: Latest Release

🎯 Perfect for both casual players and competitive gameplay!
